traces.geminiReasoning: Full 5-floor run, shadow_rogue, cautious style, survived. Narrative must reference at least 2 eventLog events. Second-person voice. Title must be unique to this specific run — the wire trap on Floor 1 and the Smoke Vial on Floor 5 are the most narratively distinct moments.

output.narrativeText: You descended into the dungeon as a shadow, and emerged as its master. Where others would have charged the Silent Watcher, you read the wire, stepped over it, and let silence do your fighting. Floor after floor, you negotiated when diplomacy served and struck only when the moment was perfect — and when the Lich's gaze swept the final chamber, a Smoke Vial bought you the breath you needed. The dungeon did not break you. You simply convinced it you were never there.
